scientific_integrity: An explicit eight-word instance proves the lower bound; an exhaustive exact-integer computation over all 65535 possible nonempty input sets and all legal greedy tie choices proves the upper bound and counts exactly four extremizers. The relevant recurrence has a mathematical justification; finite enumeration is not claimed to imply an infinite-family classification.
scientific_limitations: Exact only for distinct binary words of common length four; it does not determine the unrestricted-alphabet length-four approximation ratio or any length-five ratio. The exhaustive upper bound depends on the faithfully executed finite-state recurrence checker. No external independent audit has been performed.
title: Sharp greedy-superstring ratio and all extremizers for binary four-letter inputs
